evidence.quote: At Cost $82.70 / year renews at $82.70 … Registration 2 Year $165.40 est. renewal $82.70 … .ai domain names uniquely require registration and renewal periods of at least two years. This means that when you register a .ai domain there's a two year minimum. If you have auto-renew turned on, the domain will renew for two years instead of one as it nears expiration.
